{{Draft}}
Every field of the [[Publications]] forms, in the order of the form. Field names are given as they appear in the forms; where a field appears under another name in some forms, that name is given in brackets. Fields filled in automatically (who created or changed an entry, and when) are not listed.

'''Input:''' ''text'', ''number'', ''tick box'', ''list'' (choose from a fixed list) or a link to another record. '''Required''' fields must be filled in before saving. Long lists are shown on the [[Field reference/Base tables|Base tables]] page.

== Main form ==

|-
| '''ID Publication type''' || The kind of publication: book, article, exhibition catalogue, catalogue raisonné and so on. In the PRO menu, the bibliography can be filtered and sorted by it. || list || Book, Article in magazine, Newspaper article, Internet (blog/review/etc), Video, Audio, Other media, Works Catalogue, Exhibition Catalogue, Brochure, Flyer, Article in book, Conference proceedings, book of arrivals, Inventory catalogue, book series, Catalogue, Article in catalogue, Magazine, Supplement, Conference Paper, Thesis, Press release
|-
| '''Public''' || Tick to publish the publication. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Title''' || Title of the publication; for an article, the title of the article. || text || 
|-
| '''Subtitle''' || Subtitle. || text || 
|-
| '''Publication''' || For an article or contribution: the magazine, newspaper or book it appears in. Empty for a stand-alone book. || text || 
|-
| '''Series''' || The series the publication belongs to. || text || 
|-
| '''Alias''' || Short name shown in every list where the publication can be picked; the lists are sorted by it. Use a consistent pattern, such as author and year. || text || 
|-
| '''Abbreviation''' || Short form for footnotes, if the catalogue uses one. || text || 
|-
| '''Publication date (day)''' || Day of publication, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Publication month''' || Month of publication, if known. Leave it empty when unknown; never use January as a placeholder. || list || January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
|-
| '''Year of publication''' || Year of publication. || number || 
|-
| '''Publication city''' || Place of publication. || text ||

|-
| '''Number Copies''' || Print run, if known. || number || 
|-
| '''Volume''' || Volume number, for a work in several volumes. || number || 
|-
| '''Total Volumes''' || Number of volumes of the whole work. || number || 
|-
| '''Number Pages''' || Number of pages. || number || 
|-
| '''Page''' || For an extract: its page or pages. || text || 
|-
| '''Illustration''' || For an extract: the number of the figure or plate. || text || 
|-
| '''Coloured ?''' || For an extract: tick if the illustration is in colour. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Reference''' || A citation key or reference code. Searchable. || text || 
|-
| '''Comments''' || Internal notes for editors. Not published. || text || 
|-
| '''ISBN (books)''' || ISBN of a book. || text || 
|-
| '''ISSN (magazines)''' || ISSN of a magazine or series. || text || 
|-
| '''Link''' || Web address of the publication or of its record, for example in a library. || text || 
|}

== Publications Agents ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Agent'''<br /><small>(Agent ID)</small> || The contributor, as a directory entry. || link to a directory entry || 
|-
| '''Activity ID'''<br /><small>(Activity)</small> || The contributor's role. The byline shows only authors and editors, so record those roles as such. || list<br />'''required''' || 94 entries, see [[Field reference/Base tables#Activities|Activities]]
|-
| '''Publication Part ID'''<br /><small>(Part)</small> || The part the contributor wrote, such as an essay, the introduction or the preface. Leave empty when the role applies to the whole publication. || list || Essay, Introduction, Prologue, Epigraph, Text, Epilogue, Afterword, Conclusion, Preface
|-
| '''Publication Part Name''' || Name of the part, when it does not fit the list. || text || 
|}

== Featured artists ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Artist ID'''<br /><small>(Artist)</small> || An artist the publication is about. Only artists listed here get the publication in their bibliography. || link to an artist || 
|-
| '''Use In Web'''<br /><small>(For use in web)</small> || Tick to show the publication in the artist's bibliography on the website. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Use In CR'''<br /><small>(For use in CR)</small> || Tick to include the publication in the artist's printed catalogue raisonné. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Use As Ref CR''' || Tick if the publication is one of the authoritative references of the catalogue raisonné. || tick box || 
|}
